changes: Bind every slice/kernel/UNATTRIBUTED relation member label to the actual child scope dimension, not merely another declaration list.

Require nonempty string run ID; GLOBAL forbids slice/kernel, SLICE requires integer slice, KERNEL_INTERVAL requires integer slice+kernel, UNATTRIBUTED requires integer slice and explicit kernel=UNATTRIBUTED.
Rollup removes only its own axis dimension: kernel aggregation preserves slice population. Kernel parent is explicitly SLICE; global aggregation happens through exact slice rollup.
Validate scope/member structure even if a required count is NA. Unknown counts remain INCOMPLETE; NA cannot hide incorrect child identities.
Keep physical interval checks: disjoint contained kernel intervals are legal; overlapping, out-of-parent or mismatched slice periods invalid.
production_effect: None: /tmp-only offline checker preparation; no formal parser/native/app adoption
